question: Below what attendance percentage am I barred from a course's end-semester exam?
answer:
You are barred from a course's end-semester examination if your attendance falls below 65% [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §4 Detention].

While the standard requirement is at least 75% attendance [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §2 Minimum attendance], you may be eligible for condonation if your attendance is between 65% and 75% [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3 Condonation of attendance].

**Attendance Status Summary:**

| Attendance Range | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| 75% or higher | Eligible for exam [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §2] |
| 65% to < 75% | Eligible for exam if condonation is approved [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3] |
| Below 65% | Detained; cannot take exam [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §4] |

**Conditions for Condonation:**
*   **Grounds:** Must be based on medical or other documented reasons [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
*   **Application:** Submit an application with supporting documents to the Head of Department before the last teaching day of the term [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
*   **Fee:** A condonation fee of ₹500 per course applies [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
*   **Limit:** You may receive condonation in at most two courses per term [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
